title: hibiscus manihot var. palmatus
intro: Hibiscus manihot var. palmatus, commonly known as Yellow Cotton Bush, is a plant species that belongs to the Malvaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Cotton Bush include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
